channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Justise Winslow | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Justise Winslow from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Taylor Jenkins on his impressions of Justise Winslow:

“Our time with him was great. Obviously there were some challenging moments for him... he just had a positive attitude through all of that.”

Taylor Jenkins on Justise Winslow, Oct 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Nearly three months later, Jenkins suggested that Jackson, Winslow and Clarke should be ready to go.

“When it comes to Justise, BC and JJ, those guys are looking and feeling good,”

Taylor Jenkins on Justise Winslow, Jul 1, 2020. Source: Daily Memphian.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Justise Winslow's progress through concussion protocol:

“He's getting closer. But we're not going to skip any steps. So he's not quite ready to practice yet. But he's getting better, he's feeling better.”

Erik Spoelstra on Justise Winslow, Nov 18, 2019. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Justise Winslow
item.description:
“Not to the point where, I think, that's taken him out of being productive. For Justise to be productive, the unit has to be efficient.”

Erik Spoelstra on Justise Winslow, Feb 12, 2019. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Embiid on his block exchange with Winslow:

“It felt great. When he blocked me I didn't say anything. Good for him. He talked a lot. On the other end, I got him back. You don't really want to talk trash to me. I'm glad I got him back.”

Joel Embiid on Justise Winslow, Apr 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Jon Johnson:Joel Embiid on Winslow breaking mask:

“Little do they know I have about 50 of them. It's going to take much more than that to get me out of this series. I'm going to be a nightmare for them too.”

Joel Embiid on Justise Winslow, Apr 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @jonjohnsonwip.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Spoelstra said after Miami’s win in Phoenix.

“To work our rotation a little bit best in their strength zones is something I want to look at. Nothing is in cement right now, but I thought Justise gave us some really rock-solid minutes on both ends of the court. Defensively he was guarding one though four, literally, at different points in the game. And offensively, he showed a real nice poise with the ball in his hands, but also making some plays off the ball, when other guys were making plays. This is definitely something I hope we can build on with him.”

Erik Spoelstra on Justise Winslow, Nov 9, 2017. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Dwyane Wade on Heat,

“I watch 'em. I watch as a basketball fan. I want to see how Tyler does. I want to see how Justise is growing.”

Dwyane Wade on Justise Winslow, Nov 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
“But at the same time, Coach's attitude and my attitude is we want to win. And we don't know what we really have. But we love Hassan (Whiteside), we love Josh (Richardson) and Justise (Winslow) and Tyler (Johnson) and a lot of the other young players that we have, so I think from that standpoint, it's a wait and let's see what happens. And then we'll go from there. We're rebuilding now. We're not tweaking, like we did with the Big Three team. Or retooling, like we had to do right after LeBron left. We're rebuilding, but we're rebuilding to win now.”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Sep 26, 2016. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
Toward the close of the email, Arison wrote:

“What won't change is the culture of this organization. The Miami HEAT is a Championship organization. I fully expect this team, from Pat Riley to Head Coach Erik Spoelstra, to our veterans Chris Bosh, Udonis Haslem, Goran Dragic and Josh McRoberts, to our returning young core of Hassan Whiteside, Justise Winslow, Josh Richardson and Tyler Johnson, to the fresh faces joining the HEAT Family to continue our mantra of being the 'hardest working, best conditioned, most professional, unselfish, toughest, meanest, nastiest team in the NBA.'”

Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Aug 12, 2016. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Pat Riley on James Worthy, Jamaal Wilkes, Justise Winslow
item.description:
“I remember when James Worthy came to the Lakers and Jamaal Wilkes was the incumbent and then there came that time, there came that time when it was just a matter of time when James Worthy was going to take his position. Are we ready for Justise Winslow to start at the three? I am. I’m not just throwing him out there. This guy has been thrown out there last year and played significant minutes and significant time. I trust him. So you guys put too much on the things that he can’t do versus what he can. And those things that he can’t do, he’s going to be able to do better with more minutes.”

Pat Riley on James Worthy, Jamaal Wilkes, Justise Winslow, Jul 25, 2016. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Tyler Johnson on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Tyler Johnson on summer:

“I see the way J-Rich & Justise [defend]. They kind of take it to a whole 'nother level. That's what I want to be.”

Tyler Johnson on Justise Winslow, May 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Grant Hill on Justise Winslow
item.description:
Shandel Richardson:Grant Hill on Justise Winslow:

“No offense but he might be their (the Heat's) best defensive player.”

Grant Hill on Justise Winslow, Nov 12, 2015. Source: Twitter @ShandelRich.
